title: X_eTaL-video lesson
description: A lesson as data (docs/plan.md V3): lessons/<slug>/lesson.json. Checked by scripts/check-schema.mjs, which reads the keywords used here and no others.

slug.description: The lesson's directory name under lessons/.

stepFrames.description: The frames a stepping board holds each step (15 if not given).

demo.description: The live demo the lesson is about, if any.

seconds.description: The scene's length; with narration, the audio's length replaces it.

narration.description: What is spoken over the scene (at most 320 characters, vid-tts's limit).

curves.description: Show the three easing curves as moving dots.

boards.description: Arrays drawn as grids under the lines, each one printed by the lesson's data.xtl after a '== name' line.

numbers.description: Write each cell's number in it.

animate.description: A list of boards shown one at a time, a step each; otherwise all at once, side by side.

lines.description: Text, or code as {"code": ...}. {{f}}, {{scene}}, {{local}}, {{progress}}, {{total}}, {{secs}}, {{durs}} and {{starts}} and {{step}} are replaced by the frame's own numbers.
